reports.title: Beckman and Lewis Score Crappie Masters One Pole Victory on Truman
reports.text:
Their two-day winning weight of 21.20 pounds was enough to claim the $7500.00 championship prize along with an additional $500.00 bonus from the Missouri Corn Growers Association and American Ethanol, a $100.00 Jenko Fishing bonus for using Jenko products, and a $500.00 Midsouth Tackle bonus for winning the tournament and using Midsouth tubes.
The team caught their winning fish on black and chartreuse Bobby Garland Slab Slayers, Midsouth Tubes, and Muddy Water Baits. They were fishing on the bottom in 9 to 11 foot of water. Their equipment included 10 foot Jenko Hypersense Rods, Humminbird electronics, Minn Kota Trolling Motor, and Mercury Motor to power their boat.
